title: Improved Accuracy Scaling with Problem Complexity in LLM Arithmetic Reasoning Using Executable Symbolic Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High accuracy on mathematical benchmarks does not establish whether reasoning remains reliable as problem complexity increases. We examine how executable symbolic representations change accuracy scaling in large language models compared with natural-language reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce the GSM Arithmetic Benchmark (GSM-AB), a controlled benchmark that independently varies operand digit length and operation count to probe numerical scale and compositional complexity. We find that executable representations can improve accuracy and slow its decline as complexity increases. Lean reduces average sensitivity to operand digit length at every tested model size. By contrast, slower degradation with increasing operation count emerges at the larger model sizes. translated_title: 使用可执行符号表示改进大语言模型算术推理中准确率随问题复杂度的扩展性
translated_abstract: 在数学基准测试上取得的高准确率并不能证明当问题复杂度增加时推理依然可靠。我们研究了可执行符号表示如何改变大语言模型相比自然语言推理的准确率扩展规律。为解决这一局限，我们提出了GSM算术基准（GSM-AB），这是一个可控基准，可以独立改变操作数的位数长度和运算次数，以探测数值规模和组合复杂度的影响。我们发现可执行表示能够提高准确率，并减缓其随复杂度增加而下降的速度。在所有测试的模型规模下，Lean都降低了对操作数位长的平均敏感度。相比之下，随运算次数增加而出现的更缓慢的准确率退化现象仅在较大模型规模下出现。Python思维程序（Python-PoT）对照实验显示出类似的运算维度模式，表明这一发现并非Lean所特有。这些发现表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GSM算术基准（GSM-AB），通过独立控制操作数位长和运算次数，证明使用可执行符号表示（如Lean）能改善大语言模型算术推理的准确率扩展性，减缓准确率随问题复杂度增加而退化的速度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the GSM Arithmetic Benchmark (GSM-AB), which independently varies operand digit length and operation count, and demonstrates that executable symbolic representations like Lean improve accuracy scaling in LLM arithmetic reasoning by slowing accuracy degradation as problem complexity increases.
